liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightning** (1 review): Reviewer finds the show superb from Lazy Lightning onward [8]
- **Althea** (1 review): Attendee particularly liked Althea [14]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): The Scarlet into Fire segment is singled out as nice [7]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 other source): Playing in the Band is listed at 12:21 [1]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 review): Post-space material is called excellent, with Wharf Rat highlighted [7]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): Reviewer finds the ending of Truckin' one of the strangest they have heard [16]

## Setlist highlights

- **Fire on the Mountain**: with cut between jam & second verse [1]

## The recordings

- **gd79-12-03.sbd.bongripper.1241.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 208 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]. Said about its sound: Some tape hiss, low levels in places, and a few tape flaws [1]
- **gd79-12-03.sbd.miller.29434.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 184 min; rated 4.68/5 by 19 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the soundboard sound good; Reviewer calls it an excellent recording, though they listened only on computer speakers; Reviewer describes the audio as stellar [7][8][11][17]
- **gd79-12-03.sbd.orf.320.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 182 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Levels are very low, as the accompanying text file itself says; The original tape has abrupt starts, and quick fade-ups on this copy cover them [6]
- **gd1979-12-03.135897.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 196 min; rated 4.5/5 by 4 [3]

## Around the show

- Guests: cut between jam & second verse [1]
- Attendee sat third row center and felt energy pouring off the stage [9]
- Reviewer considers it a typical fall 1979 show [11]
- Attendee says this was the only show that year at the Uptown with Althea, Saint of Circumstance and Johnny B. Goode [14]
- Of three Uptown shows the reviewer attended, this was the most impressive [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd79-12-03.sbd.bongripper.1241.shnf**: source: See comments [1]. Also: Source tracks were analog transferred to PCM WAV, close to the master reels, ripped by a friend with good equipment [1]
- **gd79-12-03.sbd.miller.29434.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Reviewer calls this a reference copy rather than a vault tape, and prefers WaveLab over Samplitude for transfers; Set 1 came from a soundboard, to a Sony cassette master, then to DAT; Set 2 went from soundboard to cassette master, cassette, DAT, then CD; transferred and edited by Charlie Miller [2][17]
- **gd79-12-03.sbd.orf.320.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [5]
- **gd1979-12-03.135897.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by Dave Usborne; source: 2 source matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:29434), Recording Info: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/UDXL-II) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k); Set 2:… [3]
